title: Big time, Desi Arnaz's orchestra and Fred MacMurray
summary: Green drifts to the idea of big time and a Philadelphia show with Desi Arnaz's orchestra, a blond violinist and saxophonist Fred MacMurray being discovered.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Could you give us -- describe it so that we can do that -- get a picture -- get the picture?

Yes, I believe I can. It's what we call display window, and there was -- they were doing first, see, having a first -- one of a kind, like that, and hoping that it had enough appeal -- audience appeal, to become popular. You see, the public at large -- they didn't know what to expect, you know, from their own kind. They didn't know whether it was an alien, you know, a naturalized citizen or what it was -- what was going on, you know. Where was we? You know. In other words, the land of the free was -- they have overcame the crash -- the stock market crash, you know, and they're up to the late '30's, right? And they call -- what you call, big time. That's what became famous in the profession -- big time.

You see. But -- well, he had gotten an orchestra also -- Desi Arnaz. See? But he was still in the pit. You understand -- up here in the City of Brotherly Love. I think that was at the Earl Theater. And he had this great violinist -- Florenz something, you know. And he plays the violin like a toy -- he's so masterful. He had -- what is it -- Florenz Zebac -- Zeback or something -- he had this -- well, I seen him on the television, you know. He had pretty golden shiny or sun blond and he played violin. I haven't seen him in ages, I mean -- but I know he was in Mr. Arnaz' orchestra. So was Fred MacMurray. He wasa saxophone and the talent scouts got to him, you see, and Hollywood called him, you see. And it kept going, you know. And
stardom was -- once you become a star, you know, you don't get no lower -- you have to get brighter. I'm quite sure this is interesting.(laughter).
